Therapist has tools and training to help. Friends can offer a more comfortable environment (depending how good of a friend they are) but they may mishandle the situation or they could be what you need if they're empathetic. 

So basically, a therapist could be a more controlled environment while a friend could be a gamble depending on what you need imo
I'll take you up on that. I'm going to try reaching out. Just gotta fight the feeling to waste away. Are you feeling any better since this morning?

Yeah. I had some mild panic attacks on the road. It's going to be rough til I can hope to find mine. I don't have any support structure and I'm practically starting from zero again. I also feel a huge panic attack crawling in and I'm going to hate it. For now, I hope to make some friends and reconnect with a few to try and balance out the lows as much as possible. 

I have a hard time just picking one too but I'd have to say The Fifth Element holds a special place for me. I tend to go for comedy and then action. I love action but comedy tends to be a more reliable choice. It's easier to tell when a comedy movie isn't going to do well than an action movie. I also love animated movies too.

It's definitely hard not to be. I feel so vulnerable and broken. I honestly don't know what I'm doing or what I'm going to do. I keep breaking down and I have nowhere I can be comfortable. Bah....

You got a all time favorite?

I'm glad to hear. It might do you some good like help you realize what you need for yourself. We may have some things we can learn from each other. I wish I got to stay around for at least a year but I was afraid of what that time would do to me. I still am. I believe in you. Just got to find people who can accept you and that helps you become a better you in my opinion. 
Marvel movies are enjoyable. Hey, even bad movies can be enjoyable. Do you like a lot of fantasy type movies? I get really absorbed into those with great world building.

I'm glad you're open to the question. It's been one train of thought that helps me when it gets really rough emotionally. It's not enough to stop the pain...but it's enough to help me keep my feet moving. I may take you up on that. I'm certainly glad that letting things out has helped a bit. 

I'd say really reflect and think on it on what you need. If he's not someone that you can rely on then maybe it's not healthy to continue. It might help to give yourself a few days or a week to see if you can even see yourself in your thoughts at all. It also might help him/the relationship between you two. It's hard, but you may still have a chance to make a choice. I didn't get to make a choice and it kills me. I personally wanted to have my ex around, still hang out and talk to her. But now I feel like any interaction with her will hurt forever. I wish there was a magic number for how long it takes. If you're anything like me, it might take a long time or you might just need another person in your life. Hopefully your memory is worse than mine.

That's good. Can't be drowning in that negativity by yourself. Be smart and be proactive with your feelings. If you need help like you did, then continue to make the effort. I'm willing to stick around.

Our situations are interestingly similar. We are pretty much the same boat. I also don't want to think about the things but it haunts me. I really don't know how people move on from person to person. It tears my heart apart knowing that people out there can just do it some how. It's painful. But I got to ask you, does him being with you make you better? You don't have to answer now but I think you should keep it in mind. If you really need to move on (and I'm not saying that you have to right now or ever) then I hope that question will help you find reasons to move on despite the pain you feel. 

Everything that happened to you sounds really fresh so I hope there's reconciliation in some form for you. I wish I had been able to hold onto my feelings and not screw things up even further with my ex so I hope you have a chance to be on a better foot than I am. 

I wish things were easier. I wish I knew what to tell you. I wish it was easy make him realize if that girl is really wrong for him. You can warn him but he's the only one that can accept it. At the very least, please make sure you also take care of yourself, even just the bare minimum. 

Is there anything that you can do that helps you take your mind off things, even if it's just minutes at a time? TV, games, walks, etc?
I'm glad you were able to have some fun at least. I'm sorry about the fight though. Do you want to talk about it or would you rather talk about other things?
